common_gotchas: UDT In DAT was removed from TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later; prefer current UDP/TCP/WebSocket DATs for new projects.
Fast Streaming and Reliable Messaging are UDT-specific choices, not the same as ordinary UDP In DAT behavior.
Handle received messages through the callback DAT or udtinDAT class methods when sending replies.
Row/Callback Format changes the table shape and callback frequency.
Windows firewall or OS network permissions can prevent UDT traffic from arriving.
build_relevance: legacy UDT networking; removed in TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later
key_concepts: UDT In DAT is a legacy receiver for UDT fast streaming or reliable messaging connections.
Official docs mark it removed from TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later.
Callbacks handle received messages and class methods can send replies.
Protocol, address, port, and shared connection settings must match the UDT sender.
notes: Official docs mark UDT In DAT as removed from TouchDesigner 2021 Official builds and later; keep it documented for legacy-file interpretation, not new-network planning.
